items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: he did a Superman tune, a number with us

ctx.x: Pete -- well, he was called Superman. Why was that?

Well, he did a Superman tune, a number with us, and at theatres. It originally started out as a gag and it turned out to be quite a thing. And for instance, the Paramount Theatre he flew down on a wire from a very high balcony down to the stage.
